verdict.rationale: Paxos docs describe payment acceptance (PYUSD/USDC/USDP on-chain transfers), auto-conversion to fiat, and webhooks for event notifications, but nowhere mention per-customer virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses for automatic reconciliation of incoming funds. missing for 10: any documentation of per-customer/dedicated deposit addresses or virtual account assignment, reconciliation tooling tying incoming transfers to specific customers.
